authors: Jim Gunn / SDSS; June 2001 response curves, appropriate historical example with calibration approximation explicitly stated
use: External factual instrument response to specify AB photon-weighted zero point and an explicitly defined response-weighted band luminosity for PS1. No original FITS or response plot bundled.
scope_limit: Course itself does not supply absolute band energy convention; response peak-normalized and observed central spectrum treated as whole-galaxy spectral shape. This is a declared modeling choice, not a unique precision luminosity.
read_scope: AB zero point and photon weighting, 2001 g response columns; historical spSpec primary rows and bit-30 emission-line flag. Numerical measurements independent, no source plots or FITS files redistributed.
